jobs.description:
**O que procuramos?**


Estamos buscando um Desenvolvedor FullStack que integrar nosso time de tecnologia, participando do desenvolvimento de soluções digitais escaláveis, modernas e de alta qualidade. Buscamos alguém com perfil colaborativo, iniciativa e interesse em resolver desafios técnicos, aprimorar soluções e acompanhar as tendências do mercado de tecnologia.


Você atuará em diferentes etapas do ciclo de desenvolvimento de software, desde a definição técnica e implementação até os testes, implantação e evolução contínua das aplicações.

**Atribuições principais:**

* Desenvolver, evoluir e manter aplicações Full Stack, seguindo boas práticas de engenharia de software.
* Construir serviços e regras de negócio no Back\-End utilizando Python e frameworks relacionados.
* Desenvolver interfaces responsivas e intuitivas utilizando tecnologias modernas de Front\-End.
* Colaborar com Product Owners no entendimento e refinamento de requisitos, definição de critérios de aceite e evolução dos produtos.
* Atuar em conjunto com equipes multidisciplinares para entregar soluções de qualidade.
* Desenvolver e executar testes unitários, de integração, API e testes funcionais automatizados.
* Garantir a qualidade do código por meio de revisões, refatorações e aplicação de padrões de desenvolvimento.
* Participar de discussões sobre arquitetura e decisões técnicas.
* Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e atuar na otimização de performance, escalabilidade e confiabilidade das aplicações.
* Apoiar práticas de CI/CD e DevOps, contribuindo para a automação e entrega contínua.
* Identificar riscos técnicos e propor soluções para aprimorar produtos e processos.

**Requisitos:**

* Inglês avançado;
* Experiência com desenvolvimento Full Stack, utilizando **Python** no Back\-End e frameworks de Front\-End como **React ou Vue.js;**
* Conhecimento em frameworks Back\-End como **Django, FastAPI ou Flask;**
* Experiência no desenvolvimento e integração de **APIs RESTfu**l e na construção de aplicações escaláveis;
* Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e **NoSQL,** como **MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB e Couchbase;**
* Domínio de conceitos de Programação Orientada a Objetos (POO), princípios SOLID, Design Patterns e boas práticas de Clean Code.
* Experiência com desenvolvimento orientado a testes **(TDD)** e implementação de testes unitários, de integração, API e automatizados End\-to\-End.

**Diferenciais:**

* Conhecimento em práticas e ferramentas de **CI/CD** e **DevOps.**
* Experiência com **Infrastructure as Code (IaC**), automação e provisionamento de infraestrutura.
* Conhecimento em tecnologias de conteinerização, como **Docker e Kubernetes**.
* Experiência com plataformas de cloud, especialmente **Google Cloud Platform (GCP**).

**Localidade da posição: 100% remota**

**Quem é a Insi?**


Somos uma consultoria especializada em evolução digital. Mas, acima de tudo, somos uma empresa de gente. Gente que ouve antes de propor. Que vai ao essencial antes de apresentar solução. Que mede sucesso pelo que mudou de verdade, não pelo que foi implementado.


Com mais de três décadas de história e presença global, acreditamos que a verdadeira transformação começa dentro: dentro das pessoas, das equipes, das organizações — e é essa convicção que orienta cada escolha que fazemos, cada projeto que entregamos, cada pessoa que desenvolvemos.

**Por que construir sua carreira na Insi?**


Porque aqui você pensa, decide e cria junto. Oferecemos autonomia, metas claras e um ambiente onde os Insiders têm espaço para interagir com diferentes tecnologias, participar de projetos desafiadores, trazer novas ideias e trabalhar de qualquer lugar do Brasil e (por que não?) do mundo.


Somos uma das melhores empresas para se trabalhar no Brasil segundo o Great Place to Work e estamos entre os 10 melhores empregadores do Brasil segundo a revista TIME.

**Quais são nossos valores?**

* Somos pessoas servindo pessoas
* Pensamos e agimos como donos
* Temos gana por performance
* Crescemos e aprendemos juntos
* Buscamos excelência e a simplicidade
* Atuamos com criatividade e inovação


Todas as pessoas são bem\-vindas independentemente de sua condição, deficiência, etnia, crença religiosa, orientação sexual, aparência, idade ou afins. Queremos que você cresça conosco em um ambiente acolhedor e repleto de oportunidades.


Se identificou? Então, **\#VemSerInsi!**

Bellwood is a dynamic Product Development Consultancy. We're a team of developers, designers, marketers and entrepreneurs that companies turn to when they want to take a software product from conception to creation.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer with deep React and front\-end engineering experience to join our team. The ideal candidate will have experience that closely aligns with our current tech stack, particularly React, Redux, TypeScript, Vitest, Playwright, and GitHub Actions.


This is a unique opportunity to work alongside an experienced team that excels at building quality client products at scale. You'll own features end\-to\-end, raise the bar on engineering practices like testing, CI/CD, code review, and secure delivery, and help client teams build patterns that keep their products maintainable as they grow. This position reports to an Engineering Team Lead.

**Key Responsibilities Include**:

* Owning feature development end\-to\-end in React applications, from application design through implementation and release
* Establishing and improving automated quality gates, including unit, integration, and end\-to\-end testing

* Partnering with client teams to harden security and quality posture through dependency updates, vulnerability remediation, and static analysis
* Building reusable patterns and foundations, such as shared components and design system integrations, so products stay scalable and safe to evolve
* Mentoring and pairing with engineers, including client and distributed teams, on modern React and front\-end practices
* Communicating technical concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Learning and adapting quickly across a variety of technologies, tools, and client platforms, including enterprise systems you may not have worked with before
* Performing other duties as assigned

### **Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of software development experience
* Deep experience with React and Redux (or comparable state management), including application design
* Strong TypeScript experience, including integrating front ends with REST APIs and backend platforms
* Experience with React unit and integration testing, and with end\-to\-end testing
* Demonstrated code review leadership on React codebases
* Experience authoring and maintaining GitHub Actions workflows and administering GitHub repositories
* Experience building accessible, responsive UIs, ideally within a shared design system
* Strong communication, collaboration, and mentoring skills
* Ability to work effectively across multiple projects and technologies

**Experience with Vitest, Playwright, Snyk, SonarQube, Cursor or other AI\-assisted development tools, Next.js, AWS or other cloud platforms, or enterprise platforms such as IBM TRIRIGA is highly valued.**


As a senior engineer, you'll often be the technical face of Bellwood to our clients. *Compensation at Bellwood is determined by several factors, including job scope, title, and relevant experience. We offer competitive, market\-aligned pay supported by comprehensive benefits and opportunities for professional growth.*

*The estimated annual salary range for this role is $105,000 – $125,000*

* Remote work environment
* Generous PTO
* Subsidized medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Short\- and long\-term disability coverage
* 401(k) plan
* Referral bonuses
* Company retreats

### **Travel Requirements**


This position requires travel to attend two company\-wide events annually. These events are an important part of Bellwood's culture and collaboration practices. Bellwood will arrange and cover all travel and accommodation expenses.


In addition, this role includes four on\-site visits per year to our client's headquarters in Atlanta, GA. Additional travel related to client or team needs may occasionally be required.

* *Candidates in the Atlanta area will be given priority consideration*

**Join our tight\-knit team of sharp technologists to leverage your talents, expand your skills, and help build exceptional software products. We look forward to meeting you!**

jobs.description:
**We're transforming the grocery industry**



At Instacart, we invite the world to share love through food because we believe everyone should have access to the food they love and more time to enjoy it together. Where others see a simple need for grocery delivery, we see exciting complexity and endless opportunity to serve the varied needs of our community. We work to deliver an essential service that customers rely on to get their groceries and household goods, while also offering safe and flexible earnings opportunities to Instacart Personal Shoppers.



Instacart has become a lifeline for millions of people, and we’re building the team to help push our shopping cart forward. If you’re ready to do the best work of your life, come join our table.


**Instacart is a Flex First team**

There’s no one\-size fits all approach to how we do our best work. Our employees have the flexibility to choose where they do their best work—whether it’s from home, an office, or your favorite coffee shop—while staying connected and building community through regular in\-person events. Learn more about our flexible approach to where we work.

The Marketing Enablement \& Technology (MET) team sits within Instacart's Marketing organization, building the systems, APIs, and data pipelines powering Instacart's Paid Marketing channels—one of our most substantial growth levers. Operating at the intersection of Marketing, Product, and Engineering, we own the platforms behind campaign feeds, audience targeting, event pipelines, and QA automation.



We're seeking a Senior Software Engineer for the Paid MarTech pod to architect and scale backend services and ETL processes enabling marketing campaign execution, conversion tracking, and third\-party integrations across Paid Social, Display, SEM, Online Video, Linear Television, and Streaming Audio. You'll lead projects end\-to\-end, drive technical direction, mentor engineers, and partner closely with Marketing, Operations, and Product leadership to shape technical and product strategy.


***About the Job***


* Lead complete projects independently across backend services, APIs, and data pipelines, defining experimentation, development, and rollout strategies across multiple systems with minimal guidance.
* Architect scalable, robust solutions for performance, reliability, and cost efficiency, applying deep technical knowledge to design systems that handle high\-throughput marketing operations.
* Drive technical improvements by identifying and solving deeper underlying problems, designing appropriate abstractions to simplify complexity and promote reusability across the codebase.
* Partner directly with Marketing and Product stakeholders to influence features and requirements, bringing strong technical perspective while making well\-reasoned trade\-offs between complexity, business value, and delivery timelines.
* Mentor junior engineers through code reviews, technical guidance, and onboarding support, while contributing to team productivity through process improvements and automation.


***About You***


***Minimum Qualifications***


* 5–8 years of software engineering experience with expert\-level proficiency in Python for building scalable backend services, APIs, and data pipelines.
* Proven track record of leading complete projects end\-to\-end, including architecture design, implementation, experimentation, and production rollout.
* Deep expertise with data integration technologies (Snowflake, SQL, ETL processes) and workflow orchestration tools (Airflow, DBT).
* Demonstrated ability to design for performance, scalability, and robustness, with experience implementing comprehensive observability solutions (logging, metrics, tracing).
* Strong product thinking with ability to research problems deeply, influence product direction, and make strategic trade\-offs balancing technical and business considerations.
* Excellent communication skills with proven ability to mentor engineers, drive cross\-team alignment, and translate technical concepts for diverse stakeholders.


***Preferred Qualifications***


* Experience architecting and implementing automation frameworks and reusable abstractions that improve team productivity and system extensibility.
* Advanced knowledge of ad platform APIs (Google Ads, Facebook Ads, Snapchat Ads) and conversion tracking mechanisms at scale.
* Deep understanding of digital marketing operations and performance marketing KPIs (ROAS, LTV, CAC, CPA) with ability to identify technical opportunities that drive business impact.
* Experience with cloud cost optimization, chaos engineering, and disaster recovery planning.
* Track record of managing technical debt strategically and leading legacy system modernization efforts.

* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools for significant productivity improvements and contribute to AI\-assisted development infrastructure.

**Back End Developer**
======================

**Career Opportunity**
----------------------


Here's the corporate drivel HR made us put at the top: Acro Commerce is looking for a Back End Developer to build, integrate, and maintain high\-quality commerce solutions for our clients.

  

That's done. Now here's what we really want. Someone who codes like it's their native tongue, but can still talk comfortably with our crew and the odd client. You've shipped real things, you've debugged other people's messes, and you'd rather pick up a new stack than say "that's not my language." You care about writing code that the next developer won't curse you for.

  

You also know yourself. You can tell when you're stuck, and you ask for help before the deadline, not after. You can walk us through a bug that humbled you, and what you learned, without flinching. Low ego, high skills. That's the combo.

**What You’ll Do**
------------------


As a Back End Developer, you'll build and maintain the systems that help manufacturers, distributors, and brands sell online. Our client work spans a range of platforms and languages, and our developers flex between them. Right now, we're seeing a growing amount of .NET work, so if you've got .NET experience, we especially want to hear from you.

***Build \& Deliver***

* Write high\-quality, maintainable code that follows Acro Commerce standards and our production process
* Build new features, integrations, and full builds, as well as updates and revisions to existing sites
* Juggle multiple smaller tasks or larger builds with shifting priorities, and still hit your deadlines

***Problem Solving***

* Find and fix problems in code that might not be yours, where your only hint is a cryptic complaint from a client
* Provide accurate estimates for defects, builds, and new functionality, and stick to them
* Deliver efficient, practical solutions to work requests, issues, and defects

***Collaboration \& Growth***

* Communicate clearly with Project Managers, Tech Leads, and clients about work requests, problems, and defects
* Act as a peer and mentor to other developers, while being comfortable asking for help yourself
* Pick up new languages and platforms as client work demands it

**What You Bring**
------------------


We're less concerned with degrees and more with what you can actually build. Formal education is NOT required; you just need to show us you can code.

* Solid hands\-on back\-end development experience, with work samples you can share
* Experience with .NET / C\# is a strong asset
* Experience with some of what we work with day\-to\-day: PHP, Drupal, JavaScript, TypeScript, NodeJS, React, NextJS, Shopify, WordPress, AWS, Docker, Lando, Kubernetes, Acumatica
* Know other languages? Tell us. If you're a badass Lisp hacker type, mention that too.
* Comfort in a Linux shell for day\-to\-day tasks, plus some understanding of Linux hosting (bonus points if you've set up your own server, even if nobody else cared)
* Source control experience (Git, GitHub, etc.)
* An excellent internet connection and hardware that can survive an hour\-long conference call
* Fluency in English


If you've built something you're proud of and can show it, we want to see it.

**What We Bring**
-----------------

*All offers of employment with Acro Commerce are contingent on successfully completing a criminal background check.*

* **A team you'll actually like.** We take the work seriously and ourselves a lot less. Expect the occasional virtual happy hour, team competition, or reward for no particular reason. Fair warning: there are costumes. Check out our site and dissect how we do what we do.
* **Ownership and impact.** We aren't going to stick you in a corner with headphones on and call you "the IT department." Developers own this joint, and we get it. Your compensation package gets tailored to your location, experience, and your fit with our values, with hourly rates starting between $40 and $60 CAD.
* **Autonomy over your schedule.** Flexible start times, earned days off, and real remote work. Prefer to start at 8:00? 9:00? We'll work with you. Want every second Friday off? We've got a program for that. Work from your home office or from our Kelowna HQ\- your call. *(Some client contracts require staff to be located in Canada, so most positions need you to be legally able to work here.)*
* **Professional development:** We might live and breathe *software* development, but we are also really passionate about our team's *personal* development, too. We love to learn and are always striving to be the best version of ourselves; whether it's training on the latest technology or learning how to become a better delegator, we will help you improve your skills and hit your goals.


All careers come with a 30\-day no\-questions\-asked money\-back guarantee. If you are in any way unsatisfied with your career, we will return you to the workforce at absolutely NO COST to you (minus shipping and handling).
